dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let me confirm my understanding of the plan.
dialogue.zh: 我来确认一下我对计划的理解。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. What will the first version include?
dialogue.zh: 好。第一版会包含哪些内容？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Search and filters. We'll exclude export and update the board.
dialogue.zh: 搜索和筛选。我们会排除导出功能，并更新白板。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Exactly. We agree on the scope now.
dialogue.zh: 没错。现在我们对范围达成一致了。

communication_goal: 复述并确认对计划与范围的理解。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two coworkers beside a large freestanding board containing two simple abstract grouping shapes, no writing. One points at the board while the other nods. Whole board frame and stand clearly visible.

coverage_review.scope: W020 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：完整白板与支架；两组图形不证明已达成共同理解。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
